We need to determine crime(s) based on facts. The facts: leaf picking poppy fruit (opium poppy) and planting in farmland. This is illegal cultivation of poppy, which is a controlled narcotic plant. In Chinese criminal law, cultivating poppy without license is illegal. The crime is "非法种植罂粟" which falls under "非法种植毒品原植物罪" (illegal cultivation of poppy). The typical charge: "非法种植罂粟罪" or "非法种植毒品原植物罪". In Chinese law, article 347 of Criminal Law: "非法种植、买卖、运输、持有、加工、制造、走私毒品原植物" etc. So the crime is "非法种植罂粟". Also maybe "非法种植毒品原植物罪". The examples: they used "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" etc. For poppy, they likely use "非法种植罂粟". So answer: [罪名]非法种植罂粟<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法种植毒品原植物". The fact includes picking poppy fruit and planting. That's illegal cultivation. No other crimes like trafficking. So single crime.

Thus final answer.
